GAP: line 89 'remove_container_on_stop => false' overrides the module default (run.pp:244, true) on every production statement. Its outcome has no row in the outcomes table: when the service stops, the container stays (docker-run-stop.epp runs 'docker rm' only when the flag is true; the unit's ExecStop runs that script). The lab can test this with a mutating check: systemctl stop docker-docker_container, then docker ps -a shows the container Exited. Related, for the correction: the set's header says the image-change refresh keeps the container. The module's start script does 'docker rm' before 'docker create' (remove_container_on_start defaults to true), so a restart recreates the container. Restarting a killed container comes from the unit's Restart=on-failure (module default systemd_restart), not from the line 'restart_service_on_docker_refresh => true' that the-service-starts-it-again quotes. That flag only acts when docker_service is set (run.pp:698-710; the default is false), so here it does nothing.
